## Decisions

- **Copy the M1 block verbatim, including its can_grant_* functions, policies and column grants**: PSI-012's accept says 'exactly as in m1-rbac.md'; migrations are immutable (C-06), so any change to the design goes into a new migration, not into this one (alternatives: Split can_grant_* and the policies out into PSI-014; Fix the anon-executable helpers now)
- **Leave the hook and last-admin triggers out of this migration**: They are separate sections with their own tasks (PSI-013, PSI-014) (alternatives: Put all of m1-rbac.md into one migration)
- **Seed only the admin assignment**: M1 already inserts the admin role, the all-members group and the 15 permissions, and its trigger gives every seeded user a profile and membership (alternatives: Also seed test roles and groups now)
